For this model, a Hyperband tuner was used to determine the ideal number of neurons in each hidden layer and ideal learning rate that minimizes the training set error. Figure 5-24 presents the performance of the hybrid model, where the error forecasts from the DDM ensemble have been subtracted from the mechanistic model's predictions. Notably, the hybrid model residuals continued to exhibit periodicity even after applying the DDM ensemble. Recognizing this pattern, a fast Fourier transform (FFT) model was employed to capture and correct for this periodicity. A Fourier transform is a mathematical algorithm that transforms a signal from the time domain to the frequency domain, revealing its constituent frequencies. Essentially, it decomposes a complex signal into its fundamental sinusoidal components, allowing for analysis of its frequency content. Here, the FFT model uses a 1-day sliding window and the 10 most dominant frequencies within that window to make its forecasts.
